title: DOCUMENT CHECKLIST V2 — UI/UX POLISH PATCH — ISOLATED REVIEW
scope: Existing UI components and editor behavior only; schema, snapshot/mapping, templates, APIs, permissions, readiness/notification and storage code unchanged.

documentsOrder: existing client document generation and files
implementation.collapse: Existing MobileAccordion reused on all layouts; client state only, progress/count/waiting summary remain visible.
implementation.statusControl: 22px square status representation. The keyboard-accessible row opens the existing editor; no Boolean/status model added.
implementation.mos: Pre-V2 main 9a2dc23 layout audited: submitted first / documents to deliver second, side-by-side on desktop and stacked on mobile. forMos CaseChecklistItem source and every metadata field retained.
implementation.save: Shared autosave/CAS flush confirmed before closing; synchronous operation guard blocks duplicate Save and overlap with file/archive actions; failure/conflict retains editor and draft; success uses existing localized save status. Existing dialog focus restoration retained.

accessibility: Collapse header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; Space and Enter tested.
Status rows have localized editor/name/status labels, visible square empty/tick states, focus outline and full-row tap target; Enter opens editor.
Successful Save restores focus to opener; verified before and after CAS writes.
testMaintenance: The existing scheduled-notification transport regression generated events at its fixed fixture clock but delivered using wall-clock time. The test now explicitly passes the same fixture clock and normalizes fixture-only DB timestamps. No production notification/push code changed.
